header.name: Plan Callouts
header.description: Numbers and short codes on a plan view, plus a cabinet schedule, from the Kitchen Wizard cabinet data and hardware tags.

extension.caption: Plan Callouts
extension.description: Make a plan sheet with cabinet numbers, codes and a schedule.

extension.caption: Plan Callouts - Tag hardware
extension.description: Add hardware tags (trash RO, LeMans, UC wine and so on) to picked cabinets.

extension.caption: Plan Callouts - Elevations
extension.description: Make an elevation sheet: a number on every cabinet, text only for hardware and spec'd items.

extension.caption: Plan Callouts - Sections
extension.description: Make a sheet of side sections through each spec'd or hardware cabinet; the cut lines show on plan and elevation sheets.

extension.caption: Plan Callouts - Remove sections
extension.description: Delete the section objects made by Plan Callouts - Sections in this session.
